equity.level_reason: Race/ethnicity and MSM status appear only as descriptors of case composition (8 of 9 strain cases in Black persons; outbreak among MSM), with no group-specific outcomes or contrasts.

level_alternative.reason: The race and MSM counts describe a small case cluster only and are not interpreted in social-position terms.

ev.q: Eight of these nine cases occurred in Black or African American persons, and seven occurred among MSM.
Fifteen of the 29 cases were part of a large serogroup C outbreak that occurred primarily among men who have sex with men (MSM)

equity.equity_measurement: Race and MSM status are reported only as counts among cases; no population denominators by group.

notes: The 16.3% MenACWY coverage among persons with HIV is cited from an earlier claims study, not computed here. Excluding MSM outbreak-associated cases is a subset re-comparison, not stratification. Vaccination status of the 2022 cases is descriptive; no coverage or VE is computed, so vaccine_outcome_type is null.
view_issues: The figure description gives no yearly counts; only ranges for 2017–2021 appear in the text. 2022 data are preliminary.
